_note: Curated historical macro events with approximate realized 3-month factor moves. Used as few-shot reasoning anchors in LLM prompting. Values are approximate, sourced from public market data, and intended as directional reference points — not precise historical claims. Pre-1993 events have null VIX (index didn't exist yet); pre-2003 events have null breakeven (TIPS market was thin).

factor_units.returns: decimal (mkt_excess, smb, hml, mom, oil, dxy)
factor_units.bps_changes: basis points (ust10y, slope, breakeven, ig_spread, hy_spread)

events.name: Iraq invades Kuwait
events.summary: Iraq's invasion of Kuwait triggered an oil price spike and equity drawdown amid recession fears. Inflation concerns kept long rates elevated despite slowing growth.
events.lessons: Geopolitical oil shock + recession: equities fall, oil rallies hard, credit widens, USD softer (Fed easing). Pre-VIX/breakeven era — those values null.

events.name: 9/11 attacks
events.summary: Terror attacks shut markets briefly and crystallized recession. Fed cut aggressively. Flight to quality drove rates lower despite credit widening.
events.lessons: Risk-off + dovish policy pivot: rates fall sharply, oil weak (demand fears), small caps and value outperform on stimulus expectations. Curve steepens.

events.name: Lehman Brothers / GFC peak
events.summary: Lehman bankruptcy triggered systemic credit freeze. Aggressive Fed response, flight to USD and Treasuries, oil collapse on demand destruction.
events.lessons: Maximum systemic stress: everything correlates, USD rallies, credit blows out, oil crashes on demand collapse. Momentum (short losers) wins big in cross-section.

events.name: Eurozone sovereign crisis / US downgrade
events.summary: S&P downgrades US sovereign rating; peripheral Europe debt fears intensify. Risk-off, flight to quality (UST despite downgrade), VIX spike.
events.lessons: Sovereign risk + USD strength + flight to UST. Pattern resembles a milder Lehman; small caps lag.

events.name: COVID-19 pandemic onset
events.summary: Pandemic lockdowns triggered fastest equity drawdown in history. Oil briefly went negative. Massive Fed/fiscal response. Huge cross-sectional dispersion.
events.lessons: Rapid demand shock with massive policy offset. Growth/momentum dominated; value collapsed (energy/financials hit hardest). Oil shock as severe as GFC. Note: 3M cumulative includes the rebound from late-March lows.

events.name: Russia invades Ukraine
events.summary: Energy supply shock layered onto already-elevated inflation. Fed accelerated hiking. Equities sold off, value/energy outperformed, USD rallied.
events.lessons: Stagflationary shock: oil up, rates up, equities down. Value > Growth. Curve flattened on hiking expectations. Modest credit widening.

events.name: Silicon Valley Bank failure
events.summary: Regional bank failures triggered banking-stress flight to quality. Fed pivoted to more cautious tightening. Mega-cap tech rallied on AI optimism.
events.lessons: Sector-specific stress, broad indices held up via mega-cap tech. Regional banks crushed; large caps positive. Rates rallied on policy pivot expectations. Interesting case where headline stress did NOT translate to broad-market drawdown.
